get.summary: List entities linked to a document
get.description: Requires read access to the seed document in the active workspace or effective category. Returns entities from its active graph generation; graph unavailability or disabled graph search returns an empty entities array.

404.description: Document not found in the active scope.

get.summary: List related documents via graph traversal
get.description: Requires read access to the seed. Returns current-generation graph neighbors within the active workspace or effective category, ordered by hop distance then document ID. The limit applies after authorization and generation filtering. Disabled or unavailable graph search returns an empty related array.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum authorized related documents to return.

404.description: Seed document not found in the active scope.

post.description: Every seed requires read access in the active workspace or effective category before traversal. Non-blank query text filters authorized current-generation neighbors using exact-title and English or language-neutral full-text matching. Exact titles rank first, followed by lexical score and document ID. No model call is made. An omitted or blank query returns unfiltered authorized graph context ordered by hop distance then document ID. Entities always describe the seed documents and are not query-filtered. Disabled or unavailable graph search returns empty entities and relatedDocs arrays.

query.description: Optional lexical query for related documents; blank or omitted leaves graph context unfiltered.

docIds.description: Readable seed document IDs; one inaccessible seed rejects the request.

maxResults.description: Optional cap on relatedDocs after authorization, query filtering, and ranking. Does not limit seed entities. Omit to return all matches produced by the bounded graph traversal.

200.description: Seed entities and authorized related document summaries.

404.description: One or more seed documents were not found in the active scope.

get.description: Returns the current counter values and the raw duration histogram samples from the in-process metrics registry. Authenticated via `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

AccountPurgeFenced.description: The account deletion fence is active; no mutation was admitted.

uploadToken.description: Opaque signed admission identity. Return it verbatim to confirm.

WorkspaceResourceScope.description: Optional category restriction carried only in a trusted server-to-server signed workspace assertion; it is never a browser secret.

WorkspaceAssertionPayload.description: Trusted server-to-server signed workspace assertion payload. Clients must not create, alter, or expose this payload in browser code.

BearerAuth.description: Global or category-scoped DocsMint API key. The operator key is also accepted as a bearer token on operator-capable routes.
